name: Czech Republic — lakes, reservoirs, ponds and dams
title: Czech Republic — lakes, reservoirs, ponds and dams
description: Lakes, water reservoirs, fishponds, gravity dams and embankment dams located in the Czech Republic (P17 = Q213), classified in Wikidata as instances/subclasses of lake (Q23397). Each record carries Czech name, English fallback name, surface area, max depth, elevation, inflow / outflow / drainage basin labels, geographic coordinates, and a link to the Czech Wikipedia article when available. Compiled from a SPARQL query against query.wikidata.org via extract_lakes_sparql.py — companion to the rivers cluster (cs-reky) and to other lakes datasets in the cluster (tl-lawa, sk-jazera, el-limnes, da-soer).
